recursive_obs.real_outcome: A pass is worth what its suite covers: 80.2% of behaviour-altering candidates rejected here, per pair between 1 of 6 and 6 of 6. A law confirmed on the code as it stands added exactly zero on top of that, and the census shows why: the only law kind that confirms on real code is the word 'it ran', which a pass has already said, and the informative relations are refuted by the code itself. The same question asked of the tree's own learned skills: the four exercisable ones really do the edit, and the verdict attached to all eleven admits a program that writes nothing, 4 of 4.
recursive_obs.required_capability: A verdict that can speak about what a program means rather than about the shape of its definitions, plus the discipline of recording what each verdict was worth.
